scope: 39 admitted root-level blobs; current, historical, methodological, provenance and routing surface

path_primary_units.content: Citation metadata for The Correctable Lineage; carries no scientific warrant.
Documentation and research-material licensing declaration; not scientific evidence.
Copyright and licensing notice; provenance only.
Current repository gateway; routes the project to a narrow candidate governance representation and evaluation package rather than a validated general theory.
Defines the minimal reading path and precedence of current front-door documents over historical corpus material.

Translates correction-path governance into a strategic-agent threat model; explicitly not an AGI alignment solution, containment guarantee, current-system diagnosis, benchmark result, or deployment authorization.

Synthesizes adaptive transformation, epistemic governance and layered correction; proposes lowest-sufficient-layer revision and no-bypass structure without claiming a validated universal architecture.
Preserves earlier authority-acquisition chain and operational-weighting formulation; current typed epistemic/decision authority semantics supersede conflicting W meanings.
Preserves older vector/no-spillover authority formulation while explicitly surrendering precedence to the current typed authority semantics.
Organizes causal permeability, consequence coupling, inheritance and viable-future reach as a synthesis; not an independently validated law or metric.
Defines supplied-object Claim Contract Governance v0.5 and its evaluator-authored governance-loss comparison; does not establish general superiority.
Defines a future native-strength comparative study against mature alternatives with matched information, independent authoring, complexity cost and dissolution outcomes; no comparative data exist.
Develops controlled interface repair/discovery/coordination distinctions and warns that resolution, relevance, identifiability and utility are non-equivalent.
Defines maintenance policy to add conceptual structure only when behaviorally necessary and to permit absorption/demotion; policy discipline is not evidence for the scientific hypothesis.
Describes the distributed research corpus and its developmental interpretation; does not create a universal natural law or merge evidential status across repositories.
Defines v0.4 supplied correction-ecosystem benchmark including common-mode failure and availability of independent repair paths.
Defines correction-path/cut-set capture as a cross-domain structural governance hypothesis; no universal threshold or safety theorem is validated.
Separates target, observation, validation, attribution, revision and succession authorities and preserves a factorization-to-intervention no-bypass hierarchy.
Governance charter for a future comparative evaluation; explicitly not benchmark v0.6, completed study, ethics approval, preregistration substitute or evidence of framework superiority.
Preserves an earlier governed-update kernel and epistemic-topology proposal while explicitly marking older W/Sigma/Gamma operational semantics as superseded by current front-door semantics.
Records an anonymized permission-pending external identifiability-methods correction that narrows novelty claims; it does not validate downstream claim-contract utility.
Hostile pre-pilot review packet asking mature methods to identify duplication, weakened comparators, ontology leakage and absorption conditions; not review outcome evidence.
Collects failure signatures including synthetic validation, gate bypass, laundering, historical overwrite and abstraction ratchet; taxonomy is not independently validated.
Separates result validity, provenance, generative mechanism and explanation fidelity (V/P/M/X) and proposes stronger inheritance thresholds for generators than validated results.
Defines governance loss Lambda and candidate error costs; no universal loss or weights are validated and current toy benchmarks use hand-authored policies/evaluator-supplied weights.

Places Gate 1 inside mature target/query identifiability and partial-identification theory; retains only the downstream identification-boundary-to-authority-boundary rule as an open governance proposal.
Defines v0.3 supplied-channel interface-diversity benchmark and its correlated-failure/independence problem.
Defines v0.1 supplied-sensor selective-acquisition benchmark; does not demonstrate autonomous interface invention.
Defines v0.2 supplied-challenge stress benchmark and distinguishes challenge availability from challenge informativeness.
Maps conceptual phases and prior repositories while explicitly refusing to merge their evidential status; source relation assertions do not establish Cerebro endpoint identity or edges.
Maps project components to established identifiability, Bayesian, causal, assurance, belief-revision, provenance and human-factors practices; comparative distinctness remains open.
Proposes boundary-completeness, causal-orientation and dependency-propagation checks before adaptation attribution; not an executed Interface Theory gate or validated benchmark.
Records one narrow historical engagement incident from author recollection while explicitly stating original communication logs are not preserved and no general character/competence claim follows.
Defines a future blind self-location test for reconstructing current claim/evidence/defeat conditions; prior AI evaluations are exploratory only and not controlled evidence.
Uses discovery-before-accessible-derivation to separate result validity, provenance, mechanism and explanation fidelity; not a psychological reconstruction or empirical validation of the framework.

Defines the current narrow hypothesis: explicit identified-content, typed authority, scope, dependency and reopening records may reduce invalid authority transfer; human usability, comparative advantage and autonomous discovery remain unestablished.

Formalizes identified sets and admissible claim content, separates identification, epistemic authority and decision authority, and treats the downstream governance bridge as an open hypothesis rather than new identifiability mathematics.
Uses Sidis as an overextension stress case to motivate causal boundary/orientation/dependency checks; rejects the historical thermodynamic claims and creates no new empirical result.
Proposes selective inheritance plus prospective generation plus reality-correctable comparison; not a validated progress theory or universal temporal-intelligence scalar.

standing_split_units.content: Current evidence is synthetic supplied-object benchmark behavior plus conceptual/literature correction; Pilot 0 and comparative validation are not completed.
Current front-door documents control interpretation where historical files conflict; historical visibility does not imply current canonical authority.
Does not claim new identifiability theory, solved alignment, validated universal governance architecture, demonstrated human usability, or comparative superiority.
Pilot 0 has no participant data and the comparative protocol has not been executed.
Absorption into mature methods, failure of independent reconstruction, unacceptable complexity, or no comparative advantage are legitimate narrowing/dissolution outcomes.
Target/query identifiability, observational equivalence, partial identification and identified sets are treated as mature external substrate, not project novelty.
Identified content constraining typed/scoped epistemic authority transitions is a proposed governance rule whose comparative operational value remains open.
A robust action may be justified under declared loss despite unresolved mechanism; action authority does not identify the mechanism.
Older operational W semantics are historical and must not overwrite current epistemic-authority/decision-authority separation.
Older authority vector vocabulary remains developmental provenance; current front door controls conflicting semantics.
Historical W/Sigma/Gamma combinations of credence, trust, permission and deployment are explicitly superseded where inconsistent with current semantics.

External feedback increased authority that Gate 1 is standard identifiability and decreased authority for factorization-theorem novelty; downstream claim-contract utility received no direct positive update.
Reviewer identity remains permission-pending and underlying private correspondence is not publicly reproduced; the repository contains the author's summarized correction record.
The named engagement record concerns one interaction only and explicitly does not support a general claim about the person's character, competence or future conduct.
Original communication logs are absent; evidential standing is author recollection, not independently preserved interaction evidence.
Factorization, observational equivalence, identification before estimation, partial identification and auxiliary identifying structure are withdrawn from project novelty claims.
Whether explicit typed/scoped/dependency-aware/reopenable claim records improve correction beyond mature alternatives remains unestablished.
Conceptual ancestry does not merge evidential status, validate prior mechanisms, resolve endpoints, or authorize Cerebro edges.
Protocol specification is not participant data, comparative outcome, independent preregistration or ethics approval.
Evaluation governance structure does not constitute study execution or evidence of claim-contract superiority.
Making Lambda explicit does not make its stakeholders, weights or harm model legitimate; no universal loss vector is validated.
Strategic-agent threat assumptions are design requirements and do not establish that any current AI system is deceptive, conscious, hostile, stably goal-directed or controllable by this framework.

source_block_identity_note: multiple units sharing a source path are semantic standing splits, not independent sources or independent warrants
